name: Demone hero
author: - (Hakin)
description: Don’t fall up like you're supposed to at 31.5% and instead time a click to go below the saw while not dying to the spikes at 32% and then spam at the floor. Fall onto the platform above the portal at 35% and then don't click to fall to the ceiling and stay there. Go up near the floor at 65% and then fall back down onto the structure at 67% and then don't click to move back to the ceiling. Spam from 76%-78% until you can release and fall onto the bottom of the letters and then can fall to the ceiling. Stay at the ceiling until the end from there.
